title: mama’s programming :-)
author: Jayme V.
desc: 2 days per week 1 alone and 1 with me. Focus is to develop and practice the 7 functional movements patterns

ex.note: 15-20 minutes at a steady quick pace like we usually do. :)

Elevated Hands Push Up On Knees

ex.note: Seconds, not minutes. Doesn’t let me edit
